title: Energetics in daemonic work extraction protocols via non-ideal QND-energy measurement
summary: We address the problem of extracting work from a quantum system assisted by a quantum non-demolition (QND) energy measurement. When a perfect QND measurement can be performed and an auxiliary zero-temperature bath is available, the full energy of the quantum state can in principle be extracted even without any prior information on the input state. Owing to the presence of a zero-temperature bath, this is achieved at no energetic cost for the measurement process itself.
